text: Tom sa til meg at han ikke var opptatt.
translation: Tom told me he wasn't busy.

text: Tom sa at Mary ikke var opptatt.
translation: Tom said that Mary wasn't busy.

text: Jeg har vært opptatt i det siste.
translation: I've been very busy lately.

text: Toms hjerte begynte plutselig å slå fortere.
translation: Tom's heart suddenly began to beat faster.

text: Plutselig klemte han henne.
translation: All of a sudden he hugged her.

text: Toget vårt stoppet plutselig.
translation: Our train stopped suddenly.

text: Han ble sendt for å redde prinsessen.
translation: He was sent to save the princess.

text: Jeg skulle ikke ha sendt den e-posten.
translation: I shouldn't have sent that email.

text: Du har sendt melk fra gården din.
translation: You sent milk from your dairy.

text: Jeg har blitt sendt hit for å eskortere deg.
translation: I've been sent to escort you.

text: Kunne du sendt meg en brosjyre?
translation: Could you send me a brochure?

text: Tre hundre pappesker fylt med gamle klær stod klare til å bli sendt til katastrofeområdet.
translation: There were three hundred cardboard boxes filled with old clothes ready to be sent to the disaster area.

text: Mennad snakket om ting som hadde skjedd ham.
translation: Mennad talked about things that happened to him.

text: Jeg kan fortelle deg at dette ikke har skjedd.
translation: I can tell you that this has not happened.

text: Hva har skjedd mellom deg og Tom?
translation: What's up with you and Tom?

text: Jeg lurer på hva som har skjedd.
translation: I wonder what happened.

text: Det var det beste som noen gang har skjedd meg.
translation: It was the best thing that ever happened to me.

text: Hva har skjedd med babyen min?
translation: What's happened to my baby?

text: Jeg visste ikke når jeg skulle slå av maskinen.
translation: I didn't know when to switch the machine off.

text: Å slå to fluer i en smekk.
translation: To kill two birds with one stone.

text: Du er velkommen til å slå deg til oss.
translation: You're welcome to join us.

text: Slå det opp i ordboken.
translation: Look it up in your dictionary.

text: Ikke slå opp med meg.
translation: Don't break up with me.

text: Tom prøvde å slå meg.
translation: Tom tried to hit me.

text: Jeg tror det er usannsynlig at Tom blir valgt.
translation: I think it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.

text: Vi har valgt et hotell nær museene.
translation: We've chosen a hotel near the museums.

text: Hva ville du valgt?
translation: What would you choose?

text: Ingen bryr seg om hvorfor Tom er vegetarianer.
translation: Nobody cares why Tom is a vegetarian.

text: Tom bryr seg ikke om hva Mary gjør.
translation: Tom doesn't care what Mary does.

text: Jeg bryr meg ikke om hva du synes.
translation: I don't care what you think.

text: Det er ingen som bryr seg om meg.
translation: Nobody cares for me.

text: Ingen bryr seg om hva som skjer med Tom.
translation: Nobody cares what happens to Tom.

text: Ingen bryr seg om hva du mener.
translation: Nobody cares what you think.

text: La oss stoppe her og fortsette i morgen.
translation: Let's quit here and continue tomorrow.

text: Jeg kan ikke fortsette å lyve til henne.
translation: I can't keep lying to her.

text: Det var ikke Tom som lot vannet fortsette å renne.
translation: It wasn't Tom who left the water running.

text: Prisene vil fortsette å stige.
translation: Prices will continue to rise.

text: Jeg må fortsette å prøve.
translation: I have to keep trying.

text: På dødsleiet ba han meg om å fortsette å skrive til deg.
translation: On his deathbed he asked me to continue writing to you.

text: Kan du ta en dag fri?
translation: Can you get a day off?

text: Jeg har fri i dag.
translation: I've got the day off today.

text: Han tok en uke fri.
translation: He took a week off.

text: Jeg er en fri mann.
translation: I'm a free man.

text: Har du fri i kveld?
translation: Are you off tonight?

text: For et halvt års tid siden han følte seg fri som fuglen.
translation: He felt free as a bird half a year ago.

text: Ifølge Bibelen skapte Gud verden på seks dager.
translation: According to the Bible, God made the world in six days.

text: Gud hjelper den som hjelper seg selv.
translation: God helps those who help themselves.

text: For Gud er alle mennesker like.
translation: In the sight of God, all men are equal.

text: Gud er død. Vi drepte ham.
translation: God is dead. We killed him.

text: Jeg tror ikke på Gud.
translation: I don't believe in God.

text: Å du som metter liten fugl, velsign vår mat, å Gud.
translation: O you who takes care of the little birds, bless our food, O God.

text: Hyggelig å møte deg. Hvordan går det?
translation: Nice to meet you. How are you doing?

text: Det er hyggelig å se deg her.
translation: It's nice to see you here.

text: Hyggelig å treffe deg, fru Jones.
translation: Nice to meet you, Mrs Jones.

text: Jeg prøver bare å være hyggelig.
translation: I'm just trying to be friendly.

text: Mennad var en veldig hyggelig fyr.
translation: Mennad was a very nice guy.

text: God ettermiddag. Hyggelig å møte deg.
translation: Good afternoon. Nice to meet you.

text: Jeg synes det er et veldig interessant spørsmål.
translation: I think it's a very interesting question.

text: Av og til synes jeg du er veldig interessant.
translation: There are times when I find you really interesting.

text: Jeg hadde en interessant samtale med Tom.
translation: I had an interesting conversation with Tom.

text: Fransk er et veldig interessant språk.
translation: French is a very interesting language.

text: Jeg håper det skjer noe interessant.
translation: I hope something interesting happens.

text: Leser du en interessant bok?
translation: Are you reading an interesting book?

text: Lag A vant kampen mot lag B.
translation: Team A won the game against team B.

text: Vi nøt å se kampen.
translation: We enjoyed watching the game.

text: Kampen er snart over.
translation: The game's almost over.

text: Jeg skulle ønske jeg hadde dratt med de andre til kampen i går.
translation: I wish I had gone with the others to the game yesterday.

text: Dette er den eneste måten å intensivere kampen mot det tyranniske regimet i Etiopia.
translation: This is the only way to incentivize the fight against the tyrannical regime in Ethiopia.

text: Tom bore ikke på Park Street lengre.
translation: Tom doesn't live on Park Street anymore.

text: Tom bor ikke med oss lengre.
translation: Tom doesn't live with us anymore.

text: Jeg klarer ikke å gå lengre.
translation: I can't do it anymore.

text: Foreldrene til Tom lever ikke lengre.
translation: Tom's parents aren't living anymore.

text: Noen ganger sparer en tid ved å gå den lengre vei.
translation: Sometimes you save time by taking the longer road.

text: Tom sier han så folk som løp skrikende.
translation: Tom says he saw people running and screaming.

text: Da Tom så meg, løp han sin vei.
translation: When Tom saw me, he ran away.

text: Hun gikk av bussen og løp mot ham.
translation: She got off the bus and ran towards him.

text: Hvis du hører alarmen, gå, ikke løp.
translation: If you hear the alarm, walk, don't run.

text: Sami løp ut av bilen.
translation: Sami ran out of the car.

text: Han løp etter hunden sin.
translation: He ran after his dog.

text: Mamma sendte oss druer pakket i en eske.
translation: Mother sent us grapes packed in a box.

text: Mamma, jeg vil du skal kjøpe meg et granateple!
translation: Mommy, I want you to buy me a pomegranate!

text: Mamma laget en kake til bursdagen min.
translation: Mom made a cake for my birthday.

text: Du ligner veldig på mamma.
translation: You look a lot like mom.

text: Mamma! Hector plager meg!
translation: Mom! Hector's bugging me!

text: Mamma, jeg er sulten.
translation: Mom, I'm hungry.

text: Mannen kjempet tappert, men ga seg tilslutt.
translation: The man fought bravely but finally gave in.

text: Mannen som ringte for en time siden var Frank.
translation: The man who rang an hour ago was Frank.

text: Mannen hennes bor i Tokyo nå.
translation: Her husband is now living in Tokyo.

text: Hun besøkte mannen sin i fengselet.
translation: She visited her husband in prison.

text: Tom var den eneste mannen i firmaet som Mary respekterte.
translation: Tom was the only man at the company that Mary respected.

text: Han beskyldte mannen for stjeling.
translation: He accused the man of stealing.

text: Vi var helt utslitte etter fem timers reise.
translation: We felt dead from the five-hour trip.

text: Jim skal snart ta en reise til sørøst-Asia.
translation: Jim is about to take a trip to southeast Asia.

text: Når kommer du til å reise til Paris?
translation: When will you depart for Paris?

text: Jeg planlegger å reise til Europa med en venn.
translation: I'm planning to travel to Europe with a friend.

text: Hvem vil reise til Filippinene? For et tropisk paradis!
translation: Who wants to visit the Philippines? It is such a tropical paradise!

text: Hun strevet med å reise seg.
translation: She struggled to get up.

text: Jeg drar ofte til sentrum på søndager.
translation: I often go downtown on Sunday.

text: I Ming-dynastiet (tidlig 15. århundre) var den Forbudte Byen i sentrum av Beijing.
translation: In the Ming Dynasty (early 15th century) the centre of Beijing was the Forbidden City.

text: Tom har ingen sosiale ferdigheter.
translation: Tom has no social skills.

text: Jeg gikk meg vill, og for å gjøre det enda verre så begynte det å regne.
translation: I got lost, and to make it even worse, it then began to rain.

text: Du må studere hardt og lære mye.
translation: You must study hard and learn many things.

text: Du trenger ikke jobbe så hardt.
translation: You don't have to work so hard.

text: Du må virkelig jobbe hardt.
translation: You've got to work really hard.

text: Du jobber for hardt.
translation: You work too hard.

text: Hun prøver veldig hardt.
translation: She's trying really hard.

text: Du burde jobbe hardt.
translation: You should work hard.

text: Tom fant et hus han vil kjøpe.
translation: Tom found a house that he wants to buy.

text: Jeg skulle ønske jeg hadde et hus for meg selv.
translation: I wish I had a house of my own.

text: Bor dere i et stort hus?
translation: Do you live in a large house?

text: Toms hus er lett å finne.
translation: Tom's house is easy to find.

text: Jeg bor i et gammelt hus.
translation: I live in an old house.

text: Tom sitt hus har ikke elektrisitet.
translation: Tom's house doesn't have electricity.

text: Han vet veldig godt hvordan man lurer folk.
translation: He knows very well how to deceive people.

text: Jeg lurer på om Tom fortsatt er grådig.
translation: I wonder if Tom is still greedy.

text: Jeg lurer på hvorfor Tom er så grådig.
translation: I wonder why Tom is so greedy.

text: Jeg lurer på om Tom fortsatt er uheldig.
translation: I wonder if Tom is still unlucky.

text: Jeg lurer på hva som skjedde med Paul.
translation: I wonder what happened to Paul.

text: Jeg lurer på om Tom er i live.
translation: I wonder whether Tom is alive.

text: Toms mor er en meget god kokk.
translation: Tom's mother is a very good cook.

text: Oversettelsen er meget tro mot originalen.
translation: The translation is extremely faithful to the original.

text: Jeg lærte meget fra hans bøger.
translation: I learned a lot from his books.

text: Toms råd var meget til hjelp.
translation: Tom's advice was very helpful.

text: Jeg likte det meget godt.
translation: I enjoyed it very much.

text: Klokka seks passer meg veldig bra.
translation: Six o'clock will suit me very well.

text: Vennligst kom når det passer deg.
translation: Please come when it suits you.

text: Rødvin passer bra til kjøtt.
translation: Red wine goes well with meat.

text: Passer det for deg hvis jeg kommer klokken seks om ettermiddagen?
translation: Is it convenient for you if I come at 6 p.m.?

text: Den kjolen passer henne utmerket.
translation: That dress fits her perfectly.

text: Tom er ikke den rette mannen for deg.
translation: Tom isn't the right guy for you.

text: Jeg tror at det er det rette å gjøre.
translation: I think that's the right thing to do.

text: Hvis jeg lager en eksempelsetning, kan du rette den for meg?
translation: If I write an example sentence, can you correct it for me?

text: Ta deg til rette.
translation: Please make yourself at home.

text: De fleste utviklere hater feilsøking. Det er mer morro å lage feil enn å rette dem.
translation: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.

text: Han beordret hunden sin til å sitte.
translation: He ordered the dog to sit.

text: Alle vil sitte ved siden av henne.
translation: Everybody wants to sit beside her.

text: Han er vant til å sitte lenge oppe om nettene.
translation: He is used to sitting up late at night.

text: Jeg elsker å sitte på stranda.
translation: I love sitting on the beach.

text: Mary sa at hun så Tom sitte i parken alene.
translation: Mary said she saw Tom sitting in the park by himself.

text: La oss sitte på benken.
translation: Let's sit on the bench.

text: Frem til hvilket klokkeslett kan jeg sjekke inn?
translation: How late can I check in?

text: Pass på å sjekke inn senest 45 minutter før avgang.
translation: Be sure to check in at least 45 minutes prior to departure time.

text: La meg sjekke ut hva det er som skjer i naborommet.
translation: Let me see what's going on in the next room.

text: Når bør vi sjekke ut?
translation: When should we check out?

text: Husk å sjekke om gassen har blitt skrudd av før du går ut.
translation: Remember to check to make sure the gas has been turned off before you go out.

text: Hvem var det som skrev disse to brevene?
translation: Who was it who wrote these two letters?

text: Jeg brente alle brevene som du skrev til meg.
translation: I burned all the letters that you wrote me.

text: Jeg brant alle brevene du skrev meg.
translation: I burned all the letters that you wrote me.

text: Jeg rev i stykker alle brevene du skrev meg.
translation: I tore up all the letters that you wrote to me.

text: Har du sett oppskriftsboka jeg skrev?
translation: Have you seen the recipe book that I wrote?

text: Han skrev en bok i Kina.
translation: He wrote a book in China.

text: Ett bilde er verdt mer enn tusen ord.
translation: A picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Denne gesten er verdt mer enn tusen ord.
translation: This gesture is worth more than a thousand words.

text: Noen ganger en vennlig gest er mer verdt enn tusen ord.
translation: Sometimes a friendly gesture is worth more than a thousand words.

text: Hvor mye er det verdt?
translation: How much is it worth?

text: Enhver person som motiverer deg til å forbedre deg, er en person som er verdt å ta vare på.
translation: Anybody that motivates you to be better is someone who's worth keeping close.

text: Du kan fremdeles gjøre det hvis du vil.
translation: You may still do it if you want to.

text: Trass i alt, er verden fremdeles vakker.
translation: Despite everything, the world is still beautiful.

text: Jeg har fremdeles ikke hørt fra ham.
translation: I still haven't heard from him.

text: Gjør det mens du fremdeles kan.
translation: Do it while you still can.

text: Jeg er fremdeles i sjokk.
translation: I'm still in shock.

text: Hun elsket ham fremdeles.
translation: She still loved him.

text: Denne heisen kan ta 10 personer om gangen.
translation: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.

text: Det er ikke første gangen du kommer for sent.
translation: This isn't the first time that you've been late.

text: Den siste gangen jeg så deg var vi fanger.
translation: The last time I saw you we were prisoners.

text: Det var første gangen jeg gikk langs Mogami elven.
translation: It was the first time I walked along the Mogami River.

text: Gjør en ting om gangen.
translation: Do one thing at a time.

text: Jeg avholdt meg fra å kommentere den avholdte vennen min denne gangen.
translation: I restrained myself from commenting on my beloved friend this time.

text: Tom jobbet hele dagen og var helt utslitt.
translation: Tom worked all day and was completely worn out.

text: Tom jobbet for et byggefirma i Boston.
translation: Tom worked for a construction company in Boston.

text: Jeg antok Tom jobbet sammen med dere.
translation: I assumed Tom was working with you guys.

text: Han jobbet så hardt at han ødela helsen sin.
translation: He worked so hard that he ruined his health.

text: Han jobbet ti timer i et strekk.
translation: He worked ten hours at a stretch.

text: Toms fingre ble knust mens han jobbet ved samlebåndet.
translation: Tom's fingers got smashed while working on the assembly line.

text: Gratulerer med dagen, min kjære venn!
translation: Happy birthday, dear friend!

text: Å mestre et fremmed språk krever tålmodighet.
translation: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.

text: Å spille fiolin krever mye øving.
translation: Playing the violin requires much practice.

text: Nesten alle tyske universiteter er offentlige.
translation: Almost all German universities are public.

text: Ingen vet hvordan man fikser dette problemet.
translation: No one knows how to fix this problem.

text: Dette problemet kom fra en gjensidig misforståelse.
translation: This problem arose from a mutual misunderstanding.

text: Er du klar for det neste problemet?
translation: Are you ready for the next problem?

text: Tom har jobbet med problemet.
translation: Tom has been working on the problem.

text: Problemet her er ikke meg.
translation: The problem here isn't me.

text: Vi kan løse dette problemet.
translation: We can solve this problem.

text: Jeg er redd for å snakke med ham.
translation: I'm scared to talk to him.

text: Jeg er redd at du har misoppfattet meg.
translation: I'm afraid you misunderstood me.

text: Han lurer på om du er redd for slanger.
translation: He wonders if you are afraid of snakes.

text: Jeg vet ikke hvorfor jeg er redd.
translation: I don't know why I'm scared.

text: Han var redd for å gå dit.
translation: He was afraid to go there.

text: Ikke vær redd for å gjøre feil.
translation: Don't be afraid of making mistakes.

text: Tom er et sterkt barn.
translation: Tom is a strong kid.

text: Det blåser sterkt i dag.
translation: It's really windy today.

text: Det er utdanning som er nøkkelen til suksessen.
translation: It is education that is key to the success.

text: Hun viet livet sitt til utdanning.
translation: She devoted her life to education.

text: Han viet livet sitt til utdanning.
translation: He devoted his life to education.

text: Utdanning i denne verden skuffer meg.
translation: Education in this world disappoints me.

text: Velkommen til en ny og mer meningsfylt virkelighet.
translation: Welcome to a new and more meaningful reality.

text: Du er mer enn velkommen til å komme.
translation: You're more than welcome to come.

text: Du er velkommen her når som helst, Tom.
translation: You're welcome here anytime, Tom.

text: Du er velkommen til å komme med oss.
translation: You're welcome to join us.

text: Velkommen ombord Flight 123 til Los Angeles.
translation: Welcome aboard Flight 123 to Los Angeles.

text: Du er hjertelig velkommen til å komme.
translation: You're more than welcome to come.

text: Jeg venter her til han kommer tilbake.
translation: I'll wait here until he comes back.

text: Jeg venter på et anrop fra Tom.
translation: I'm waiting for a call from Tom.

text: Fortell Tom at jeg venter på ham.
translation: Tell Tom I'm waiting for him.

text: Jeg venter en kunde i dag.
translation: I'm expecting a customer today.

text: Jeg venter barn på nyåret!
translation: I'm expecting a baby in the new year!

text: Så, hva venter du på?
translation: So, what are you waiting for?

text: Jeg er ikke så god i engelsk ennå.
translation: I'm not good at speaking English yet.

text: Han oversatte Homer fra gresk til engelsk.
translation: He translated Homer from the Greek into English.

text: Han snakker bedre engelsk enn jeg gjør.
translation: He speaks English better than I do.

text: Jeg har aldri hørt han snakke engelsk.
translation: I have never heard him speak English.

text: Jeg skulle ønske jeg kunne snakke engelsk.
translation: I wish I could speak English.

text: Hvorfor ønsker du å lære engelsk?
translation: Why do you want to learn English?

text: Helse betyr alt for meg.
translation: Health means everything to me.

text: Jeg har foreldrene mine å takke for at jeg har så god helse.
translation: I owe it to my parents that I am so healthy.

text: Alle borgere har retten til helse og et liv som møter de kulturelle minimums-standardene.
translation: Every citizen has the right to health and to a life that meets the minimum cultural standards.

text: Anatomiske brystimplantater vil imidlertid også kunne gi en formendring på brystets formen hvis de roterer sideveis.
translation: Anatomical breast implants, however, can also deform the shape of the breast if they rotate sideways.

text: Hun liker ikke maten som Bríd lager.
translation: She doesn't like the food that Bríd makes.

text: Jeg lager ikke mat på mandager. Sønnen min gjør det.
translation: I don't cook on Mondays. My son does.

text: De lager et eller annet her.
translation: They're making something or other here.

text: Jeg liker ikke maten Tom lager.
translation: I don't like Tom's cooking.

text: Jeg lager brownies med Tom.
translation: I'm making brownies with Tom.

text: Hvordan lager du røyken?
translation: How do you make the smoke?

text: Penger bringer ikke alltid lykke.
translation: Money does not always bring happiness.

text: Å strebe etter maksimeringen av egen nytte, lykke eller trygghet synes svært naturlig for et menneske.
translation: To strive for maximization of self interest, happiness or security seems very natural for a human being.

text: Jeg tenker på deg, og smiler. Takk for minnene som fyller mitt hjerte til randen med lykke.
translation: I think of you, and I smile. Thank you for the memories which fill my heart to the brim with happiness.

text: Jeg mente aldri at dette skulle skje.
translation: I never meant for this to happen.

text: Han mente ikke å såre deg.
translation: He did not intend to hurt your feelings.

text: Jeg mente ikke å si det.
translation: I did not intend to say that.

text: Jeg mente ikke å gjøre det.
translation: I didn't mean to do that.

text: Unnskyld! Jeg mente det ikke.
translation: I'm sorry, I didn't mean it.

text: Jeg mente ikke å skrike.
translation: I didn't mean to yell.

text: Jeg har alltid ansett deg som en nær venn.
translation: I've always considered you a close friend.

text: Jeg skulle ønske du var nær meg.
translation: I wish you were close to me.

text: Det er ikke på langt nær nok.
translation: It isn't nearly enough.

text: Jeg vil bare være nær deg.
translation: I just want to be near you.

text: Huset mitt er nær Tokyo-tårnet.
translation: My house is near Tokyo Tower.

text: Skolen vår er nær stasjonen.
translation: Our school is near the station.

text: Dette skjønner jeg rett og slett ikke.
translation: I simply don't understand this.

text: Dette er rett og slett løgn!
translation: This is an outright lie!

text: Jeg er slett ikke overbevist.
translation: I'm not convinced at all.

text: Ikke slett denne eksempelsetningen.
translation: Do not delete this example sentence.

text: Ikke snakk stygt om andre.
translation: Don't say bad things about others.

text: Ikke snakk med dem nå.
translation: Don't talk to them now.

text: Ikke snakk så eplekjekt.
translation: Don't be so haughty in your speaking.

text: Snakk med vennene dine.
translation: Chat with your friends.

text: Jeg skulle ønske jeg hadde tenkt på det.
translation: I wish I'd thought of that.

text: Han hadde tenkt å gifte seg med henne.
translation: He intended to marry her.

text: Vi har tenkt å bli en uke.
translation: We plan to stay a week.

text: Jeg har gått og tenkt på det i hele dag.
translation: I've been thinking about it the entire day.

text: Jeg har tenkt mye på dette.
translation: I've thought about this a great deal.

text: Hvor lenge har du tenkt å bli i dette landet?
translation: How long do you plan to stay in this country?

text: Den fyren er totalt sprø!
translation: That guy is totally nuts!

text: Mine planer mislyktes totalt.
translation: My plans failed miserably.

text: De eneste våpen jeg har i mitt hjem er vannpistoler.
translation: The only weapons I have in my home are water pistols.

text: Gammelt brød kan noen ganger bli brukt som et dødelig våpen.
translation: Old bread can sometimes be used as a mortal weapon.

text: Ingen våpen ble funnet.
translation: No weapon was found.

text: Døren ble åpnet av en høy mann.
translation: The door was opened by a tall man.

text: Ikke langt fra oss er det en skole, som ble åpnet nylig.
translation: Not far from us is a newly opened school.

text: Tom åpnet fort brevet.
translation: Tom quickly opened the letter.

text: Han åpnet munnen sin.
translation: He opened his mouth.

text: Ønsket ditt vil gå i oppfyllelse i nær framtid.
translation: Your wish will come true in the near future.

text: Jeg ønsket ikke at dette skulle skje.
translation: I didn't want this to happen.

text: Men han ønsket seg virkelig en sønn.
translation: But he really wanted a son.

text: Tom og Mary ønsket at de ikke hadde gjort det.
translation: Tom and Mary wished they hadn't done that.

text: England er et land jeg lenge har ønsket å besøke.
translation: England is a country that I've wanted to visit for a long time.

text: Jeg har skrevet en roman akkurat slik jeg ønsket å skrive den.
translation: I wrote a novel exactly as I wanted to write it.

text: Tom vet nok hva som må gjøres.
translation: Tom will probably know what needs to be done.

text: Hva mer kan gjøres?

text: Røyking er strengt forbudt.
translation: Smoking is strictly prohibited.

text: Maria har god kjennskap til driftsforskrifter og tekniske forskrifter.
translation: Mary has good knowledge of working instructions and technical regulations.

text: Disse tekniske begrepene stammer fra Gresk.
translation: These technical terms derive from Greek.

text: Ordrekkefølgen i latin er fri, men ikke tilfeldig.
translation: Latin word order is free, but not arbitrary.

text: Det var helt tilfeldig at han vant kampen.
translation: It was pure chance that he won the game.

text: Det var et tilfeldig møte.
translation: It was an accidental meeting.

text: Jeg møtte henne tilfeldig.
translation: I met her by accident.

text: Veien er i en sørgelig tilstand.
translation: The road is in a deplorable state.

text: Jeg er ganske glad Tom og Mary er trygge.
translation: I'm very happy Tom and Mary are safe.

text: Tom har vært uvanlig stille i dag.
translation: Tom has been unusually quiet today.

text: Det er ikke uvanlig.
translation: That's not uncommon.

text: Pass på så du ikke går deg vill.
translation: Be careful that you don't get lost.

text: Han vill en dag bli en god fotballspiller.
translation: He will become a good football player one day.

text: Det ser ut som dere har gått dere vill.
translation: You guys look lost.

text: Uten det kartet, ville han nok ha gått seg vill.
translation: Without the map, he would have gotten lost.

text: Har du gått deg vill?
translation: Are you lost?

text: Jeg foretok en analyse som viste at det ville trengs mye mer penger enn de tidligere hadde regnet med.
translation: I carried out an analysis that showed that much more money would be needed than they had previously anticipated.

text: Jeg kunne ikke se Tom sitt ansikt.
translation: I couldn't see Tom's face.

text: Jeg kunne ikke se Toms ansikt.
translation: I couldn't see Tom's face.

text: Vi sto ansikt til ansikt.
translation: We stood face to face.

text: Toms ansikt er rødt.
translation: Tom's face is red.

text: Jeg er godt bevisst på faktaene.
translation: I'm well aware of the facts.

text: Er du bevisst på at Okinawa er nærmere Kina enn Honshu?
translation: Are you aware that Okinawa is closer to China than to Honshu?

text: Broren min er dobbelt så tung som meg.
translation: My brother is twice as heavy as me.

text: Han er dobbelt så gammel som henne.
translation: He is twice as old as she is.

text: Det gjennomsnittlige amerikanske boarealet er dobbelt så stort som det japanske.
translation: The average American living space is twice as large as the living space in Japan.

text: Tom var ikke redd for døden.
translation: Tom wasn't afraid of death.

text: Retten dømte ham til døden.
translation: The court sentenced him to death.

text: Hvem er jeg? Hvor kommer jeg fra? Finnes det et liv etter døden? Hva er meningen med livet på jorden?
translation: Who am I? Where do I come from? Is there life after death? What is the meaning of life on earth?

text: De tjente penger ved å selge narkotika til det enorme markedet.
translation: They made money by selling drugs into the huge market.

text: Den evige sne synes ikke så evig lenger.
translation: The eternal snow seems not so eternal anymore.

text: Vi vil alle være evig unge.
translation: We all want to be forever young.

text: Kan du fikse den ødelagte radioen?
translation: Can you fix the broken radio?

text: Det går ikke å fikse motoren.
translation: I can't fix the engine.

text: Det er umulig å fikse.
translation: It's impossible to fix.

text: Jeg møtte en gammel venn på flyplassen.
translation: I met an old friend at the airport.

text: Da jeg ankom flyplassen, så jeg flyet ta av.
translation: Arriving at the airport, I saw the plane taking off.

text: Da jeg ankom på flyplassen, hadde flyet allerede lettet.
translation: The plane had already taken off when I reached the airport.

text: Flyplassen er ikke langt fra her.
translation: The airport isn't far from here.

text: Hvor langt borte er flyplassen?
translation: How far away is the airport?

text: Jeg er på flyplassen nå.
translation: I'm at the airport now.
